offering_description.value: Owns and operates live entertainment venues in New York and Chicago, including Madison Square Garden, Radio City Music Hall and several theaters. It earns money from ticketed events, venue rentals, sponsorships, food and beverage sales, and a hospitality business of restaurants, nightclubs and day clubs. It also produces live shows such as the Christmas Spectacular.

primary_products.value: event tickets; food and beverage; merchandise; sponsorship and signage packages

primary_services.value: live event hosting; venue licensing to sports teams and promoters; restaurant and nightclub operation; live show production

customer_segment.value: B2C: concertgoers, sports fans, theater audiences, restaurant and nightlife patrons; B2B: sports teams, concert promoters, corporate sponsors and advertisers, event renters

end_markets.value: live entertainment; sports; hospitality and nightlife; advertising and sponsorship

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: ticket sales and venue license fees from events and sports teams; product sales: food, beverage and merchandise sold at venues and restaurants; other: sponsorship, signage and suite and club rights fees
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; product sales; other

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and runs arenas and theaters, hosting events for fans, promoters and teams; service provider: operates restaurants, nightclubs and day clubs for consumers; brand owner: produces and markets live shows sold to audiences
value_chain_position.category: asset operator; service provider; brand owner

geography_served.value: US regional: New York City and Chicago venues, hospitality venues in several US cities, plus a few international locations

specialization.value: related lines: live entertainment venues, show production and hospitality venues sharing audiences and brands

distribution_channels.value: own locations: owned venues, restaurants, nightclubs and day clubs; online: ticket sales through its own sites and ticketing platforms; direct sales: sponsorship, suite and corporate hospitality sales

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: liquor licensing, building safety and occupancy rules, labor rules, and local permits for venues and nightlife

notes: Hospitality locations outside New York and Chicago are not detailed here.
